all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: integration-index.json receipts the generator, the four reconciled sources and both emitted outputs by content hash; verification recomputes every one of them from the live repository, regeneration is byte-identical, and a file in the bundle that no receipt covers is refused

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: the compatibility binding is a valid Draft 2020-12 schema whose references resolve to canonical $ids and which declares no enum, const, pattern or format of its own; the index and parity record keep exact field sets with recomputable hashes and account for exactly the sealed C05 membership

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: all four receipts are re-derived from the live repository and must agree on every member; every canonical fixture validates against its own schema and, where one governs it, its C05 composite; divergence, staleness, tampering and re-sealing are each refused with a typed code, and a deleted output is repaired byte-identically by re-emitting

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: the EF4-I41 boundary is proved with the repository's own fixtures: each of the eleven genome-family records that merely describe variation must be refused as a candidate, as must the evaluator and holdout fixtures, and a bundle whose candidate composite was widened is refused as AUTHORITY_IN_MUTABLE_SPACE
